title: Catalogue retrieval
description: The retriever's output and the pool's input: whether the catalogue could be searched, and what each search came back with. It carries NO PRODUCTS — the searches are recorded as they return, with every value the catalogue gave, so no model retypes product data. A search that found nothing because a budget excluded everything names the cheapest product it excluded, and that figure is how a bad allocation is corrected.

isAvailable.description: False when no tool was offered or a tool failed, so nothing was composed from memory.

unavailableReason.description: A one-line reason, present when isAvailable is false.

searches.description: One entry per search the retriever made, including the ones that found nothing.

found.description: How many products the search returned.

reason.description: The tool's own words when it found nothing, in particular when a budget excluded everything - it is the only place the cheapest matching product is stated.
